title: Chicken Pintxo and Avocado Toast

items: Cilantro, paprika, garlic, olive oil and salt, for the chicken marinade
Pan de cristal or baguette, sliced
1 oz yogurt sauce: equal parts Greek yogurt and lemon juice, with oil and salt to taste
1 oz mojo verde, a cilantro, oil and garlic sauce

steps: Marinate the chicken thighs in cilantro, a lot of paprika, garlic, olive oil and a little salt.
Grill the chicken skewers until fully cooked. The source also describes finishing the chicken in an oven.
Toast the sliced bread in a convection oven for about 3 minutes, until crisp and light brown. Spread the mashed avocado evenly on the toast.
Mix the marinated onions and capers with the 8 tomato slices until coated. Place the tomatoes in the center of a bowl and top with marinade.
Crisscross the avocado toast over the tomatoes and arrange the chicken skewers on top, leaning one over the other. Decorate with tomatoes, yogurt sauce and mojo verde.
reviewFlags: The source does not specify quantities or marinating time for the chicken marinade, the oven temperature, or how to prepare the marinated onions and mojo verde. Confirm these details before cooking.
headnote: Draft: The source leaves several marinade and sauce details unspecified. Adapted from Bulla Gastrobar Restaurante.
